record.body:
## Rationale

Red-first on `method: tdd` task closes still proves new behavior. Extending it to the phase suite would require deliberate full-suite failure before merge—pure waste. Dropping red-first for tdd would weaken the task evidence ladder without fixing suite cost. Keep the existing close-batch rule; leave suite as run-and-gate-per-policy.

## Counter-argument

Softening or removing red-first would reduce friction on repair/check-shaped work often mis-tagged as tdd. That is a separate method-hygiene issue; it should not ride along with suite policy.

payload.alternatives: drop red-first; extend red-first to phase suite
payload.choice: keep red-first for method tdd only; suite never red-first
